items.information:
*[Slovenščina]*

**To tekmovanje je priznano kot slovensko državno prvenstvo 2023!**
Tekmovanje organizira Rubik klub Slovenija.
Če potrebujete dodatne informacije ali če bi želeli spremeniti svojo prijavo, nam pišite na **wca.slovenia@gmail.com**.

Za več informacij preverite zavihke!

*[English]*

**This competition is recognized as Slovenian Championship 2023!**
Competition is being organized by the Rubik klub Slovenija.
If you need any additional information, or if you would like to change your registration, please write an e-mail to the **wca.slovenia@gmail.com**.

For more information, please check the tabs!

items.name: Slovenian FMC Nationals 2023
items.information:

**To je samo FMC tekmovanje slovenskega državnega prvenstva 2023!** Za ostale discipline preverite tekmovanje [Slovenian Nationals 2023](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SlovenianNationals2023).
Tekmovanje organizira Rubik klub Slovenija.
Če potrebujete dodatne informacije ali če bi želeli spremeniti svojo prijavo, nam pišite na **wca.slovenia@gmail.com**.

Za več informacij preverite zavihke!

*[English]*

**This is the FMC only competition of Slovenian Championship 2023!** For other events check competition [Slovenian Nationals 2023](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SlovenianNationals2023).
Competition is being organized by the Rubik klub Slovenija.
